messages:
Priya Patel: Quick heads-up — evening enablement workshop for NovaHealth on WED 7pm PT needs a host swap. Original host (Kara) has an exec conflict. Can someone pick up facilitation or pair with Kara? Also want to capture live feedback and run the short post-session survey. Tagging tz-friendly folks: @Maya @Diego @Liam
Maya Chen: I can cover facilitation if it's a 60m block. Which agenda are we using?
Priya Patel: Thanks! Agenda is the usual: 0-10m intro & goals, 10-30m config walkthrough, 30-50m hands-on lab, 50-60m Q/A + next steps. Putting final agenda in Confluence: https://go.redwood/enablement/nova-7pm
Diego Alvarez: I can co-facilitate the lab segment and manage breakout rooms. 7pm PT works for me. Re: feedback — can we use the 3-question pulse survey we used last quarter? shortlink: https://forms.gle/pulse-survey
Liam O'Connor: I'll own note-taking + post-session follow-up (capture action items in the CS tracker). I'll also publish the survey link in the chat during the last 5 minutes.
Priya Patel: Awesome. calendar-bot — can you update the invite to include the feedback link + recording consent blurb in the description? Also add Maya as co-host.
calendar-bot: Updated event 'NovaHealth Enablement — 7pm PT' — added description with feedback link and recording consent. Co-hosts updated. Invitees notified.
Maya Chen: Two quick asks: 1) Can someone upload the demo dataset to the shared bucket so customers can download during the lab? 2) Need explicit co-host Zoom role assigned (so I can move people into breakouts).
Diego Alvarez: I'll push the demo data to s3 and share link here: s3://redwood-enable/demo/nova.zip (will make public for the session only).
Liam O'Connor: Zoom co-host role added for Maya in the invite. I'll also prep a 1-slide recap for the intro.
Priya Patel: Perfect. Post-session plan: quick debrief in this channel (10min) to surface any renewal risks or blockers, then Liam publishes notes and updates the account health doc. Kara — if you can still join for Q/A that'd be ideal.
Kara (CS Manager): Happy to join the Q/A for the final 15. Thanks for covering the host slot!
Priya Patel: Locking in: Maya = facilitator, Diego = lab + demo data, Liam = notes + survey, Kara = Q/A. After the session: share notes + survey results link in #customer-success and update account health doc (link: https://go.redwood/account-health/nova). :thumbsup:
Liam O'Connor: Will post notes within 2 hours after the session and flag any renewal concerns with the redwood-renewals handle.
Priya Patel: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick shuffle. See you at 7pm PT. If anything changes, ping here and I'll re-assign. :slightly_smiling_face:
